title: Squirrel waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tail behind the body -->
  <path d='M62 78 C92 74 94 40 76 26 C64 16 52 22 52 34 C52 44 62 48 68 42 C72 38 70 32 64 32 C60 32 58 36 60 40 C58 38 56 34 60 30 C66 24 76 30 76 42 C76 60 68 68 58 72 Z' fill='#c4702a'/>
  <path d='M60 74 C80 70 82 46 70 36' fill='none' stroke='#e8a34f' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='66' rx='18' ry='20' fill='#d9822b'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='70' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#f2e2c4'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='86' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#b5621f'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='86' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#b5621f'/>

  <path d='M32 60 C26 64 24 68 26 72' fill='none' stroke='#c4702a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm waving up -->
  <path d='M60 58 C68 52 72 44 72 36' fill='none' stroke='#c4702a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='73' cy='33' r='6' fill='#e8a34f'/>

  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='16' fill='#e89542'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='27' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#e89542'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='27' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#e89542'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='27' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#f2c9a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='27' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#f2c9a0'/>
  <!-- Cheeks / muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='46' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#f7e6cc'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='37' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='37' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose and smile -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='2' fill='#7a3f14'/>
  <path d='M40 48 Q44 52 48 48' fill='none' stroke='#7a3f14' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Acorn in lower hand -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='74' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#a86b2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='70' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#c08a4a'/>
  <path d='M26 70 L26 67' stroke='#6b4423' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
